🚨 𝗧𝗵𝗲 ₹𝟭𝟴 𝗟𝗣𝗔 𝗢𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗿 𝗧𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗪𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗽 🚨

The offer letter looked 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗲𝗰𝘁. Official letterhead. HR WhatsApp group. 😨
Just one step: pay ₹𝟮,𝟱𝟬𝟬 to "confirm."

Priya never even interviewed with them — and 𝟭𝟬,𝟬𝟬𝟬+ 𝗳𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗵𝗲𝗿𝘀 fell for this exact scam.
